title: Piquent Sauce
preamble:
Ingredients:-
1
pint malt vinegar
2
heaped tablespoons plain flour, I used very heaped and it was a bit too thick
1
level teaspoon salt, I left the salt out but I think it does need some
2
tablespoons golden syrup, I think 3 big tablespoons may be better
1
level Tablespoon dry English mustard
1/2
ounce pickling spice
instead of pickling spice 1 Tablespoon curry powder can be used.

1
pint malt vinegar
2
heaped tablespoons plain flour, I used very heaped and it was a bit too thick
1
level teaspoon salt, I left the salt out but I think it does need some
2
tablespoons golden syrup, I think 3 big tablespoons may be better
1
level Tablespoon dry English mustard
1/2
ounce pickling spice

Method:-
Put all ingredients into a pan.
Boil together for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Work through a metal sieve with a wooden spoon.
Allow to cool a little then pour into sterilised bottles.
To darken the sauce add gravy browning.
Note - this sauce keeps well.
